# SwitchContinuationInLoop

<Badge type="danger" text="error" /> <Badge type="tip" text="on by default" /> <Badge type="tip" text="quick-fix" /> 

Group: [Probable bugs](/rules/#probable-bugs) · PhpStorm name: `SwitchContinuationInLoopInspection`

PHP treats `switch` as a loop structure for `continue`, so a bare `continue`
inside a `switch` only leaves the `switch` (like `break`) instead of starting
the next iteration of the surrounding loop. `continue 2` is what was meant.

## Example

::: code-group

```php{6,9} [Before]
<?php
function dispatch(array $events) {
    while ($e = array_shift($events)) {
        switch ($e->type) {
            case 'skip':
                continue;
            case 'retry':
                if ($e->tries > 3) {
                    continue;
                }
                continue 2;
            case 'batch':
                for ($i = 0; $i < 2; $i++) {
                    continue;
                }
                break;
            case 'later':
                $cb = function () { continue; };
                break;
        }
    }
}
```

```php [After fix]
<?php
function dispatch(array $events) {
    while ($e = array_shift($events)) {
        switch ($e->type) {
            case 'skip':
                continue 2;
            case 'retry':
                if ($e->tries > 3) {
                    continue 2;
                }
                continue 2;
            case 'batch':
                for ($i = 0; $i < 2; $i++) {
                    continue;
                }
                break;
            case 'later':
                $cb = function () { continue; };
                break;
        }
    }
}
```

:::

Reported:

<ul>
<li>line 6: Inside &#39;switch&#39;, &#39;continue&#39; acts like &#39;break&#39;; use &#39;continue 2&#39; to reach the loop.</li>
<li>line 9: Inside &#39;switch&#39;, &#39;continue&#39; acts like &#39;break&#39;; use &#39;continue 2&#39; to reach the loop.</li>
</ul>

## Configure

In [`custos.json`](/guide/configuration):

```json
{
  "rules": {
    "SwitchContinuationInLoop": {
      "enabled": false
    }
  }
}
```

## Suppress

Before the statement or declaration (or the first statement of the file), either of:

```php
// @custos-ignore SwitchContinuationInLoop

/**
 * @noinspection SwitchContinuationInLoopInspection
 */
```
